name: Tracy McInnes
headline: Chief Marketing Officer
about:
Accomplished senior leader with extensive experience in operations and marketing, including executive leadership, brand strategy, business growth, and integrated marketing. Visionary strategist with global experience and a record of developing and implementing transformative business plans. Proven success leading high-performing teams, launching new products, driving rebrands, and increasing customer acquisition and retention. Adept at managing cross-functional teams, client relationships, and digital transformation initiatives. Known for delivering measurable results, operational efficiencies, and innovative marketing solutions.

Expertise: Strategic Brand Development, Integrated Marketing, Digital Platforms and Campaigns, Team Leadership, Client Relationships, Financial and Budget Oversight and Management, Employee Development and Coaching.

Client experience: 
Applejack Wine & Spirits, Audi of America, Callaway Golf, The North Face, Oakley, The Sports Authority, Aspen Ski Company, Winter Park and Mary Jane Resorts, Airwalk, Sears Roebuck and Company and the Colorado Lottery.

Start-up experience:
Beatport, Jookt, LikeMe, Muse Studio

Nonprofit experience:
Judi's House, Denver Health - Newborns in Need, Project Cure, Excelsior Youth Center, Cherry Hills Village Art Commission, The Ad Council, Wish for Wheels, American Transplant Foundation
… more

experiences.description:
Led all aspects of marketing strategy, planning, and execution across digital and traditional channels for a $65M omnichannel retailer. Directed an internal marketing team and multiple external agency partners while serving as a key member of the executive leadership team.

Orchestrated annual multimillion-dollar, data driven integrated media strategies across programmatic (CTV and OTT), digital, SEO, email, paid social, OOH, radio, and direct mail, maximizing channel efficiency and driving measurable revenue growth.

Directed and managed the NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced (SCA) eCommerce platform, leading development, customization, and ongoing optimization of a fully ERP-integrated, enterprise commerce site. Delivered a unified omnichannel experience with real-time synchronization of inventory, pricing, orders, and customer data, including storefront UX, SEO, marketing integrations, and scalable architecture that improved conversion performance.  

Built and activated strategic partnerships with major suppliers, including Sazerac, Beam Suntory, Constellation Brands, Union des Grands Crus de Bordeaux, and Coors Distributing Company, driving integrated campaigns and revenue growth.
                                            
Implemented AI-powered analytics to strengthen customer segmentation, campaign optimization, and content development, accelerating go-to-market timelines and improving measurable ROI.

Provided strategic marketing and operational consulting to businesses seeking brand development, process improvement, and digital integration. Collaborated with leadership teams to design growth strategies and streamline operations.

Delivered marketing and business expertise to clients including Applejack Wine & Spirits, Excelsior Youth Center, and Allstate Insurance.

Guided RFP processes, social media integration, and staff development initiatives.

Oversaw all client-facing divisions: Strategy, Creative, Digital, Media, and Account Services for a full-service advertising agency. Drove organizational growth and led cross-functional teams in delivering award-winning campaigns for global brands including Audi of America, The North Face, Callaway Golf, and Oakley.

Expanded agency revenue from $2M to more than $50M through strategic growth initiatives and client acquisition.

Directed the agency’s annual business planning process, aligning creative vision with financial performance and long-term objectives.

Designed and implemented agency-wide operational processes that streamlined collaboration and enhanced efficiency across all departments.

Recruited, developed, and led a high-performing team of 250+ professionals, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and creative excellence.
